jobs.description: We are looking for a high-performing and career-driven Production Support Associate (PSA) to join our Manila team, supporting global markets and some of the world’s top brands. This role is ideal for candidates who are eager to grow, develop new skills, and build a long-term career with us. The PSA is responsible for managing the end-to-end order process, including sales order creation, purchase order generation, proof approvals, quality checks, shipping, tracking, and invoicing. This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Successful candidates will have experience in sales operations, order management, or branded merchandising, with a proactive approach to problem-solving and a desire to take on new challenges. If you are looking for an opportunity to develop your career, take ownership of your work, and contribute to a growing team, we’d love to hear from you

jobs.title: Asset Manager
jobs.description: The Beverage RTM Asset Manager leads the strategy and governance of Monde Nissin’s beverage chiller and cold-asset portfolio across channels, customers, and territories. The role ensures that assets are strategically deployed, commercially productive, properly maintained, and managed throughout their lifecycle in support of beverage growth and route-to-market priorities. Key Responsibilities Lead the strategy, planning, budgeting, and productivity management of beverage chillers, coolers, and other cold assets. Manage the end-to-end asset deployment process, including outlet qualification, approvals, installation, tagging, handover, and post-deployment review. Optimize asset placement, capacity, assortment, visibility, and utilization to improve cold availability and beverage conversion. Govern asset maintenance and lifecycle management, including repairs, preventive maintenance, refurbishment, replacement, redeployment, recovery, and retirement. Drive cross-functional collaboration with Sales, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, distributors, customers, and service providers to ensure strong execution and governance.

jobs.description: Are you interested in being part of a mission-driven fintech company? WIBS PHP INC. is a BSP-licensed Electronic Money Issuer EMI and Virtual Asset Service Provider VASP company in the Philippines. We are building a secure, compliant, and transparent digital finance ecosystem that supports modern payment, wallet, and virtual asset services. As we continue to grow, we are looking for an Internal Audit Associate who can help evaluate internal controls, review operational processes, test compliance with company policies, identify control weaknesses, and support audit reporting and follow-up activities. This role is suitable for candidates who want to grow in internal audit, risk management, compliance review, internal control, governance, and audit documentation within a regulated fintech company. You do not need to be a crypto expert. However, you must be willing to learn how internal audit, compliance, finance, operations, and risk management work in an EMI/VASP environment. What You’ll Do Internal Audit and Control Testing Assist in planning, performing, and documenting internal audit procedures. Review business processes, internal controls, and operational procedures. Test whether departments follow approved policies, procedures, and control activities. Check the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of documents, records, and supporting evidence. Identify control weaknesses, process gaps, documentation issues, and potential risk areas. Assist in validating whether corrective actions were properly implemented. Risk, Governance, and Compliance Review Support reviews related to operational risk, financial controls, compliance processes, and governance procedures. Assist in checking whether company activities are aligned with internal policies and regulatory expectations. jobs.title: Customer Service Officer
jobs.description: Kitchen Warehouse is Australia's leading kitchenware retailer, and our Manila office is the offshore hub supporting our Australian stores and online business. As a Customer Service Representative, you are the first point of contact for our customers, helping them across email, live chat and calls. You will resolve enquiries, process returns, and coordinate with suppliers, stores and our despatch team to deliver a smooth, accurate and genuinely helpful experience for every customer. What you will do Assist customers with enquiries submitted through email, live chat and calls. Process customer returns accurately and on time. Communicate with suppliers regarding product queries and warranty claims. Communicate with stores regarding customer orders and enquiries. Review orders and advise customers of progress or action taken. Communicate with Warehouse Despatch in regard to customer orders. Liaise with and assist the Customer Service Support Officer. Liaise with Australia Post regarding delayed or missing parcels. Identify customer complaints and escalate to the Customer Service Team or Customer Service Manager as required. Follow procedures, guidelines and policies accurately to complete assigned tasks. Perform data entry across a number of platforms. Work hours and days based on the requirements of the business (for example, Sunday to Thursday between 6am and 8pm). Assist with other additional tasks as required. Sign in Bonus : Php 10,000

jobs.description: The purpose of the Procurement Officer is to help the organization secure the best deals / contracts from suppliers that are needed for the fulfillment of business objectives. The Procurement Officer is responsible for assessing products, services and suppliers and negotiating contracts. The Production Associate will be charge of identifying potential supplier sources, screening them, and negotiating favorable contract terms. The Procurement Officer oversees coordination with suppliers for both administrative and campaigns-related purchase requirements. The Procurement Officer will help secure the best suppliers needed to fulfill a business objective while ensuring that procurement policies are implemented especially in the aide of audit and BIR requirements. This position requires experience on objective evaluation of the overall value of the proposals sent by suppliers. Evaluation of proposals will include determining: Right Quality Right Quantity Right Time Right Source Right Price Right Place Building and maintaining professional supplier-company relationship is also part of the Production Associate’s role. jobs.title: HR Governance, Compliance and Contract Risk Manager
jobs.description: Job Summary This role establishes and maintains the Company’s HR governance and compliance framework, ensuring adherence to labor laws, internal policies, and contractual risk standards. The role serves as the organization’s subject matter expert in labor compliance and employee relations, while conducting structured risk reviews of commercial contracts to protect the Company from legal, financial, and reputational exposure. It functions as a risk control and compliance gatekeeper, working closely with Legal, Finance, and relevant business units to ensure appropriate safeguards are in place before execution. Main Responsibilities: 1. Labor Law Compliance & HR Governance Interpret and apply Philippine labor laws, DOLE issuances, and related regulations. Ensure compliance with statutory labor standards and internal HR policies. Monitor regulatory developments and recommend policy or process adjustments. Conduct HR compliance reviews and risk assessments. Maintain and strengthen HR governance frameworks, controls, and documentation standards. 2. Employee Relations & Case Management Lead and oversee complex employee relations matters, including investigations, due process proceedings, disciplinary actions, grievances, harassment and misconduct, performance cases, and termination/separation matters. Prepare, review, and ensure the legal defensibility of employee relations documentation, including Notices to Explain (NTEs), Notices of Hearing, disciplinary decisions, memoranda, settlement agreements, case summaries, and reports. 3. Contract Risk Review & Governance Review commercial contracts to identify and mitigate legal, financial, and reputational risks. Assess contractual obligations, deliverables, liability, indemnity, risk allocation, termination, cancellation, breach, and other key provisions.
